text.tspan: Life science patents granted, by filing office
Patents granted within the fields of medical technology, biotechnology, and pharmaceuticals by filing office.
These patents cover a wide range of innovations, including new drugs, medical devices, diagnostic methods,
genetic engineering techniques, and biotechnological processes.

tspan.tspan: Totals by geographical region are WIPO estimates. Each region includes the following number of offices: Africa (34), Asia (46), Europe

text.tspan: (44), Latin America and the Caribbean (31), Northern America (2) and Oceania (7).
